passages.aquarium: The City Aquarium open hours are 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily. General admission is $18 for adults and $10 for children under 12. Shark feedings take place on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 2:00 p.m. Parking in the north lot is free for members.
passages.workshop: The woodworking guild meets every Saturday morning in Studio 4. Safety glasses and closed-toe shoes are required at all times. Lathes may only be operated after passing the introductory safety check. Monthly dues are $35, payable on the first of each month.
passages.shuttle: The downtown connector shuttle departs every 20 minutes from Central Station. Weekday service runs until 11:00 p.m., while weekend service ends at 8:00 p.m. Transfers to the light rail are free with a digital pass. Bicycles are allowed on the rear rack only.
